Jane · Listen & Shadow 04

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · SPRING 2020
👤 Friend
Where were you in the spring of 2020?
2020년 봄에 넌 어디 있었어?
spring — 봄
💬 Jane
Back then, I was working at FedEx.
그땐 FedEx에서 일하고 있었어.
back then — 그 당시엔
같은 패턴으로 — Back then, I was living in Busan. · Back then, we were all working from home.
💬 Jane
I remember checking the news every morning.
매일 아침 뉴스를 확인했던 게 기억나.
check — 확인하다
같은 패턴으로 — I remember waiting in line for masks. · I remember calling home every week.
💬 Jane
Everyone was waiting for a vaccine.
다들 백신이 언제 나올지만 기다렸지.
vaccine — 백신
PART 2 · THE CAST
👤 Friend
So the drug company can't run the trial alone?
근데 제약사가 혼자 임상을 못 한다며?
run — 진행하다, 운영하다
💬 Jane
Right. The sponsor makes the drug, but it can't run the trial alone.
응. 스폰서는 약을 만들지만, 시험은 혼자 못 돌려.
sponsor — 스폰서(의뢰 제약사)
같은 패턴으로 — The brand designs the shoe, but it can't make it alone. · The airline sells the ticket, but it can't run the airport.
💬 Jane
A CRO runs the trial for them — that's ICON.
CRO가 대신 시험을 굴려 — 그게 ICON이야.
CRO — 임상시험수탁기관
💬 Jane
ICON has worked with Pfizer for thirty years.
ICON은 화이자랑 30년을 일해온 회사야.
work with ~ — ~와 협력하다
같은 패턴으로 — We've worked with that carrier for ten years. · She has worked with them since 2015.
💬 Jane
The sites are the hospitals where people actually got the shot.
사이트는 사람들이 실제로 주사를 맞은 병원들이고.
site — (임상)시험 기관 · shot — 주사
같은 패턴으로 — The depots are the warehouses where the boxes actually sat.
💬 Jane
Over forty thousand people joined the trial.
4만 명 넘게 시험에 참여했어.
over — ~ 이상 · join — 참여하다
PART 3 · THREE GATES
👤 Friend
Why does it need three gates?
왜 관문이 세 개나 필요해?
gate — 관문
💬 Jane
Phase one asks if it's safe.
1상은 안전한지 물어.
phase — 단계, 상 · safe — 안전한
같은 패턴으로 — Phase one checks the dose. · The first step asks if it's possible.
💬 Jane
Phase two asks if it works.
2상은 효과가 있는지 묻고.
work — 효과가 있다
💬 Jane
Phase three asks if it works for everyone.
3상은 모두에게 통하는지 물어.
everyone — 모든 사람
PART 4 · THEN WHAT
👤 Friend
So once it's approved, it's done, right?
승인 나고 나면 끝난 거 아니야?
approve — 승인하다
💬 Jane
My guess is the real problem came after the approval.
내 생각엔 진짜 문제는 승인 다음에 왔어.
approval — 승인
같은 패턴으로 — My guess is the cost was the real issue. · My guess is they knew before we did.
💬 Jane
The vaccine had to stay at minus seventy degrees.
그 백신은 영하 70도를 유지해야 했거든.
minus — 영하
같은 패턴으로 — The samples had to stay frozen. · The boxes had to stay upright.
💬 Jane
It would take special containers to move it.
옮기려면 특수 컨테이너가 필요했을 거야.
container — 컨테이너
같은 패턴으로 — It would take a bigger truck to move that. · It would take weeks to clear customs.
👤 Friend
So that's why the logistics companies mattered so much.
그래서 물류 회사들이 그렇게 중요했구나.
logistics — 물류 · matter — 중요하다
같은 패턴으로 — So that's why the timing mattered. · So that's why everyone watched the airports.
💬 Jane
And that company in the story is where I'm headed.
그리고 그 실화의 그 회사가, 내가 들어갈 회사야.
be headed — ~로 향하다
같은 패턴으로 — That team is where I'm headed. · That city is where we're headed next year.
느리게 20/20 · 보통 20/20
